_comment: Hero prompts for beets-ai.com resource pages. Skin tone is specified explicitly: left to itself the model renders grey/ashen skin, or its pale-European 'light peach' default, neither of which is right for a Hong Kong school audience (Billy, 2026-10-10). The system prompt here matches the house style (see skill beets-ai-blog-images / references/educational-style.md). Kept in the repo so a hero can be REGENERATED rather than re-invented. Note the deliberate rule learned on 2026-10-10: no screens, boards, grids or documents with writing — those surfaces make the model add garbled lettering ('Hong Kong education', 'C4D', 'HOSPITAL'). People in a plain room, with blank coloured objects, come back clean. MODEL NOTE 2026-10-10: these 14 heroes were generated with `qwen-image`, which DashScope has since RETIRED ('Model not exist' on every call) — the replacement in the `model` field below is the closest match that still works, so a regeneration of any of these will be a re-generation, not a reproduction. Probe the model list before assuming any name still exists; the whole lineup rotates without notice.
system: Flat vector editorial illustration for a Hong Kong education website. {scene} Every person shown is ethnically Chinese with warm LIGHT-TO-MEDIUM TAN skin, in the warm beige-to-tan range typical of Hong Kong — not pale peach, not white, and never grey, ashen, washed-out or blue-tinted. Skin colour is saturated and warm. Clean geometric shapes, soft flat colour, no lettering anywhere, generous white space on the right, calm and encouraging mood.
negative: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, label, signage, poster, whiteboard writing, screen interface, chart labels, watermark, signature, logo, photorealistic, hyperrealistic, 3D render, glossy plastic, neon, cluttered, busy background, distorted face, extra fingers, uncanny, scary, dark, moody, horror, gibberish signage, copyrighted character, grey skin, grey skin tone, ashen skin, greyish complexion, pale washed-out skin, white skin, blue-tinted skin, desaturated skin, sickly complexion
